name: Robin Hood

crownPassive.name: No Crown
crownPassive.text: While he stands in slot 1 you have no Crown, and the enemy wins only by killing all your heroes.

bond.name: Outlaw's Call
bond.text: Your other Albion heroes have +1 Speed.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard Ranged attack: damage equal to Attack, on any enemy card.

actions.name: Split the Arrow
actions.text: A Ranged attack for 2 on an enemy card of your choice and 2 on another enemy card at random.

rules: If he moves out of slot 1, whoever stands there wears the Crown. If he dies in slot 1, No Crown lasts.
With No Crown, no other hero's Crown passive is active.
Longbowmen hit the hero in slot 1 instead, or the closest hero if slot 1 is empty.
An enemy Baba Yaga can't move onto your slot 1, as if it held a Crown.
